# Scenario: inbound.port + cert-issue-type mock → self-signed HTTPS on that host
# port (PEMs under mockcerts/port-<port>/; live HTTPS curl).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: port mock https fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'cert issued name=port-9443 mode=mock'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/infra/mockcerts/port-9443/fullchain.pem
exists $HOME/infra/mockcerts/port-9443/privkey.pem

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

# Self-signed HTTPS on the inbound port (not plain HTTP).
# Retry: nginx -s reload can briefly refuse TLS while workers swap.
exec sh -c 'for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do curl -skf https://127.0.0.1:9443/ && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo "HTTPS on :9443 never became ready" >&2; exit 1'
stdout 'OK'
! exec curl -sf --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:9443/

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9443
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: mock

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
